types: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (A : Set X) (a : ℝ), 0 < a → YuiMeasure a A = MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure a A

∀ k : ℕ, (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧ (∀ z : YuiEucl (k + 1), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧ (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = Real.sqrt ((dist x y) ^ 2 + |t-u| ^ 2)) ∧ LipschitzWith 1 (YuiHead (n := k)) ∧ LipschitzWith 1 (YuiLast (n := k))
∀ (k l : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiEucl k)) (g : A → YuiEucl l), Isometry g → dimH (Set.range g) = dimH A
